analogy.rationale: Bacterial antifolates inhibit DHFR, so the human DHFR inhibitor class should share the same downstream folate/one-carbon and nucleotide-synthesis program; thymidylate synthase inhibition also blocks the same pathway. Because these drugs target the bacterial enzyme and are used at 10 uM in human cells with limited DHFR engagement, the response is expected to be weak.
